dimensions.assessment: Directly targets current or former holders of specific high-level federal positions, such as the President, Vice President, Cabinet-level officials, and Members of Congress, plus related persons.
dimensions.evidence: The term covered person means any individual who has served in a position described in paragraph (2), and any person related

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a 100 percent tax on qualifying civil action amounts received from the United States, effectively reclaiming the entire damage payout.
dimensions.evidence: there is hereby imposed on each covered person for any taxable year a tax equal to 100 percent of the qualified civil action amount

dimensions.assessment: Raises federal tax revenue equal to any qualified civil action damages paid out to covered individuals, though instances of such payouts are likely infrequent.
Amends the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 by adding a new chapter for these specific civil damages.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to impose a tax on damages received by certain officers of the United States

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change to the tax code applying to amounts received after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply with respect to amounts received after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Historical frequency or projected total dollar amount of such civil damage awards against the United States for covered officials
importance_detail.rationale: The bill imposes a 100 percent tax on certain civil damages received from the United States by high-ranking federal officers, including the President, and related persons.
